svg.title: Separate spatial and temporal sensitivity of measured speed
svg.desc: Three meshes at a fixed0.01ms step and four steps at400cells produce a convergence comparison of the same two physical sensor locations. No universal error order or physiological conduction-speed accuracy is asserted from this table.
